title: Where to Purchase Official FO (FO): Full Guide
content: Purchasing Official FO (FO) requires navigating the decentralized finance infrastructure prevalent within the [Solana](/solana) blockchain, where many meme-centric assets are primarily traded. Given the project's high-risk profile, highlighted by a TokenRadar Risk [Score](/score) of 7, potential participants should prioritize security and due diligence before interacting with any decentralized exchange (DEX). This guide outlines the standard procedures for acquiring FO as of May 7, 2026.
